title: Derived direct image
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]; it is in particular a morphism of ringed spaces $(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(S,\mathcal O_S)$. The *derived direct image* $Rf_*:D(\mathcal{O}_X)\to D(\mathcal{O}_S)$, on the derived categories of [def-pc-derived-category], is the derived direct image [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image] of this morphism of ringed spaces (computed by K-injective resolutions). For $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ and $i\in\mathbf Z$, the $\mathcal O_S$-module $R^if_*E:=H^i(Rf_*E)$, the $i$-th cohomology sheaf of $Rf_*E$, is the $i$-th *higher direct image* of $E$; for an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ it is applied to $\mathcal F$ viewed as a complex in degree $0$.
